title: flare/logout/v1
description: The server and the label of the token that was revoked and deleted, and whether one was.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

label.description:
The label of the revoked token, which is empty when nothing was
revoked.

revoked.description:
Whether a saved token was revoked and deleted. It is false when no
token was saved, as with a token command and no earlier login.
